BiblicalUsage: Menahem is the son of Gadi, who took the throne of Israel by the sword and held it ten years. 2 Kings 15:14 says he went up from Tirzah to Samaria and smote Shallum and slew him and reigned in his stead, and 2 Kings 15:16 records the cruelty of his campaign at Tiphsah. 2 Kings 15:17 dates his reign to the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Menahem is a warning written in a reign: a king who comes by murder rules by cruelty, and the ten years are remembered for both.
